chapters.text: Move every Bitrix lead into AMS with its responsible person, project, activities, timeline comments and stage history.
In Bitrix: Developer resources → Other → Inbound webhook. Tick CRM and Users, save, and copy the “Webhook to call REST API” link.
In AMS: Settings → CRM → Import from Bitrix → Connect to Bitrix. Paste the link and press Read everything from Bitrix (2–5 minutes).
Check the responsible people (names with no match can be added as old employees) and projects, keep “Keep AMS in sync” ticked, and press Import.
To start again from scratch, use Start fresh at the bottom first: every lead is backed up to Excel, then deleted.
Afterwards run Leads → Duplicates → Merge all. The SQL Lab file upload still works too, but it has no comments and stops at 10,000 rows.
